prompt:

Asset type: 3x3 angry speech-mouth atlas for an existing 64x64 Daggerfall Unity pixel-art portrait

Identity and palette: same woman, original nose base, cheeks, jaw, chin, neck, hair edges and background. Keep muted tan/brown skin with soft low contrast. Keep lips at original small pixel scale and dark brown, never red or pink lipstick. Angry expression: firm tense mouth with gently tightened lip corners, consistent across all nine poses. Do not change nose, jaw, head scale or skin texture. Change only lips and the minimal mouth interior needed by the pose.
Exact Rhubarb meanings:
A: closed pressured P/B/M lips, firm brown lips held together.
B: narrow opening with teeth nearly together for consonants and EE.
C: medium unrounded opening for EH/AE.
D: wide opening for AA, anatomically plausible but still original mouth scale.
E: slightly rounded AO/ER opening, no wider than C.
F: puckered UW/OW/W lips.
G: upper teeth touching lower lip for F/V.
H: tongue raised behind upper teeth for L, opening between C and D.
X: relaxed closed idle pose; for this angry set, keep lips fully closed while retaining same restrained tense angry mouth expression.
Palette and detail: dark brown lips, subdued original skin colors, low contrast, natural pixel-art shading. Add only small soft ivory teeth and a restrained dark oral cavity where that pose needs them.
Composition: exact 3x3 grid, complete edge-to-edge cells, no extra margins.
Avoid: full faces, eye region, labels, borders, grid lines, padding, extra cells, red lipstick, pink lipstick, orange skin, enlarged cartoon lips, oversized teeth, harsh black outline, smoothing, blur, antialiasing, color grading, changes to nose/jaw/hair/neck/background, missing or partial cells.
